intents.title: Append-only ledger under refs/afwe/ledger
intents.statement: Add ledger.rs: one event per commit under refs/afwe/ledger/<project_id>, built through a private index, advanced with update-ref compare-and-swap and retried three times. Schema version 1, and a newer version is refused rather than read partially.

intents.title: Stable project id in the manifest
intents.statement: Generate a lowercase hex project id once at first ledger use and persist it in project.id, so clones and worktrees agree on the ref name without using the display name.

intents.title: Record every opened turn
intents.statement: turn.begin appends a turn_recorded event best effort: a repo without git or a ledger error logs and never stops the turn from opening.

intents.title: Read the ledger through the API
intents.statement: Expose ledger.show through api::call so the CLI, MCP and Studio can read the chain without new plumbing.
